title: 稳市政策与“六张网”托底，强非农和高利率压制估值，跨境并购与科技项目分化
summary: 国务院完善稳市机制与“六张网”建设提供政策支撑；美国强非农推高加息预期，隔夜科技修复但道指仍弱。华新建材、香港交易所列条件关注，汇聚科技因显著负面价格反馈列回避。

关键词云图

利好利空中性w1-w5表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
美国10月非农大幅超预期，12月加息预期升温
新增非农就业16.5万人，远高于Reuters调查的6.5万人；失业率降至4.1%。10年期美债收益率升至约4.86%，市场计入的12月加息概率升至约78%，高估值成长股仍受压。来源：Reuters。
国际
伊朗局势缓和预期令油价周一开盘回落
Trump称若谈判取得强有力协议，新一轮攻击可能不再必要；Reuters最新更新显示Brent约跌0.64%至97.67美元。海峡航运事件仍使地缘溢价难以完全消退。来源：Reuters。
政策
国常会要求完善资本市场稳市机制
11月6日国务院常务会议要求增强股市内在稳定性，并加快重大项目和“六张网”建设，支持设备更新和无形资产投资。政策方向有利于风险偏好，但不等于个股即时买点。来源：国务院常务会议。
政策
国家发展改革委推进“六网协同”项目与场景
国家发展改革委要求抓紧配套政策、项目库、信息共享和要素保障，支持“六网协同”新场景。算力、通信、能源和物流基础设施是潜在映射，订单仍需公司公告确认。来源：国家发展改革委。
科技
工信部拟建立统一机器人产品“身份证”
《机器人产品标识码管理暂行办法》公开征求意见，拟用统一标识码规范生产制造并支撑安全治理。当前仍是征求意见稿，不把政策方向等同于企业收入。来源：工业和信息化部。
科技
北京经开区加码开源开放信创与前沿场景
政策聚焦人工智能、6G、量子信息、超节点服务器和AI终端等首试首用，部分场景支持最高3000万元；属于区域产业政策，受益对象仍需逐一核验。来源：北京市政府。
材料
商务部对欧盟对位芳纶长丝发起反倾销调查
调查自11月6日起启动，覆盖芳纶1414长丝。国内材料企业可能受关注，但立案不等于最终征税，需求、价格与产能利用率仍需验证。来源：商务部。
公告
杰创智能签署49.15亿元算力技术服务合同
合同暂定总额49.15亿元、期限60个月，按月结算并分批交付。大额合同强化AI云服务线索，但客户履约、资本投入、交付节奏和利润率仍是核心风险。来源：财联社周末公告汇总。
公告
国际复材拟投11.58亿元建设高性能电子纤维布项目
项目规划年产1.11亿米电子级玻璃纤维布，建设期约11个月。方向对应电子材料国产化，但产能投放、爬坡和下游需求决定兑现速度。来源：财联社周末公告汇总。
港股
香港交易所首三季收入与利润双位数增长
首三季收入及其他收益246亿港元、同比增12%，股东应占利润154亿港元、增15%；但11月6日股价收385.60港元、跌2.28%，基本面与价格反馈出现背离。来源：HKEX、收盘行情。
公告
华新建材拟约16.42亿美元收购巴西水泥资产
公司拟收购CSN Cimentos 99.99%股权，股权代价约90.337亿巴西雷亚尔；标的2026年上半年亏损，交易仍需中巴审批。11月6日收27.46元、涨2.16%，价格早于周末正式披露。来源：巨潮资讯、行情。
港股
汇聚科技拟24个月内回购不超过5亿港元股份
公司拟以内部资源在公开市场回购；但11月6日收9.96港元、跌13.01%，公告当日价格反馈显著负面，回购意向不足以抵消弱势。来源：公司公告索引、行情。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
科技修复获确认，但道指与利率仍显示分化
11月6日收盘，QQQ 656.10美元、+1.40%，SPY 735.29美元、+0.35%，DIA 512.22美元、-0.39%；SOX反弹4.2%。强非农同时推高收益率，因此属于科技超跌修复而非全面风险偏好回归。
板块对照
广告、电力与激光雷达领涨，博彩行业仍最弱
Moomoo快照显示广告代理+6.73%、独立电力生产商+6.68%；概念端激光雷达+14.57%、加密矿企+12.67%。博彩行业-6.43%。运行时公开行情与EVC、OKLO、INDI、IREN等同向，稀土代表UURAF未取得独立报价，保留待确认。
A/H映射
核电、稀土与传感器映射待A/H开盘确认，广告缺少清晰映射
独立电力、铀与太空强势为A/H核电设备、关键材料和航天链提供潜在映射；激光雷达对应车载传感器。11月6日A/H宽度仍弱，故均标为“潜在反转、待今日确认”；博彩弱势对澳门链偏负面，广告代理不强行映射。

盘前结论

政策侧：稳市机制、第三批互换便利与“六张网”建设形成托底，基建、算力和自主科技具备事件线索。

海外侧：强非农把12月加息概率推至约78%，10年期收益率维持4.86%附近；科技反弹仍受高利率和AI资本开支质疑约束。

执行侧：A/H尚未开盘，所有公司卡均以11月6日收盘或公告为依据；今日只在价格和成交确认后升级，不把周末消息倒填成已确认行情。

重点个股关注

华新建材
600801.SH / 06655.HK
条件关注

事实与状态：拟约16.42亿美元收购巴西第二大水泥商99.99%股权；A股11月6日收27.46元、涨2.16%，但价格早于周末正式公告。

确认条件：今日开盘后守住27.46元并明显强于建材板块，同时披露融资、审批与整合安排的可执行进展。

风险与失效：标的2026年上半年亏损，交易涉及汇率、债务置换和中巴审批；跌破前收并持续弱于板块则观察逻辑失效。

香港交易所
00388.HK
条件关注

事实与状态：首三季收入及利润分别同比增12%和15%，但业绩公布日收385.60港元、跌2.28%，价格未确认基本面利好。

确认条件：重新站上388港元开盘区并持续强于恒指，成交活跃度与IPO收入趋势继续兑现。

风险与失效：市场成交回落、IPO周期波动或继续跌破382.40港元当日低点，均使条件关注失效。

汇聚科技
01729.HK
回避

事实与状态：公司宣布24个月内拟回购不超过5亿港元，但11月6日收9.96港元、跌13.01%，公告当日出现明确负面价格反馈。

重新评估条件：公司实际执行回购、成交量恢复正常并重新站上10.66港元当日高点后，再核验基本面。

风险与失效：回购为授权意向而非已完成买入，波动和流动性风险高；在价格反转前不包装为多头机会。

板块轮动看板

政策支撑资本市场稳市机制、回购再贷款与六张网项目，对金融、基建和算力链形成边际支持
海外修复半导体、激光雷达、电力与铀反弹，但强非农和高收益率限制估值扩张
事件主线跨境并购、算力合同、电子材料扩产与机器人标识码，均需订单、审批或交付验证
压力方向博彩、弱价格反馈与高波动小盘股；回购意向不能覆盖显著下跌

逻辑链

强非农 → 加息概率与收益率上升 → 高估值A/H科技仍需谨慎。
QQQ与SOX反弹 + 激光雷达、电力、铀领涨 → A/H传感器、核电和材料链出现映射 → 等今日开盘确认。
稳市机制 + 六张网与回购再贷款 → 风险偏好获得政策托底 → 但不替代个股价格确认。
华新并购与港交所业绩有业务依据 → 价格反馈一强一弱 → 均只列条件关注。
汇聚科技回购意向 + 当日跌13.01% → 负面价格反馈优先 → 维持回避。

风险雷达

利率与估值美国就业强劲，12月加息概率升高，科技反弹可能快速回吐。
并购与合同兑现大额交易仍涉及审批、融资、交付和利润率，公告金额不等于当期收入。
负面价格反馈汇聚科技和港交所均未获得即时价格确认，不得用公告标题掩盖市场分歧。
数据时点AKShare为11月6日14:48盘中快照；A/H候选价格为11月6日收盘，今晨开盘前无实时价。

Keyword Cloud

Market supportStrong payrollsHigh yieldsSix NetworksRobot IDsConcept reboundCross-border M&AHKEX resultsNegative feedbackData downgrade
PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 denotes importance, not price change.
Major News
Global
Strong October US payrolls lift December hike odds
Payrolls rose by 165,000 versus a 65,000 Reuters consensus, while unemployment fell to 4.1%. The 10-year Treasury yield moved near 4.86% and December hike odds rose to about 78%, keeping pressure on expensive growth stocks. Source: Reuters.
Global
Oil eases at Monday's open on Iran de-escalation hopes
Trump said further attacks may not be necessary if negotiations deliver a strong agreement. Reuters' latest update put Brent down about 0.64% at $97.67, although shipping incidents keep geopolitical risk elevated. Source: Reuters.
Policy
State Council calls for a stronger market-stabilization mechanism
The Nov 6 meeting also called for faster Six Networks projects and support for equipment and intangible-asset investment. The direction helps sentiment but is not an automatic stock-level buy signal. Source: State Council meeting.
Policy
NDRC advances Six Networks projects and scenarios
The NDRC called for supporting policies, project pipelines, information sharing and factor guarantees. Computing, telecom, energy and logistics infrastructure are potential beneficiaries, but orders require company-level confirmation. Source: NDRC.
Tech
MIIT proposes a unified robot product identity code
The consultation draft would standardize manufacturing and support safety governance. It remains a draft and is not treated as corporate revenue. Source: MIIT.
Tech
Beijing E-Town expands support for open-source IT and frontier pilots
The policy covers AI, 6G, quantum information, supernode servers and AI terminals, with some pilot support up to RMB30 million. Beneficiaries still require company-level verification. Source: Beijing Government.
Materials
MOFCOM opens anti-dumping probe into EU para-aramid filament
The Nov 6 probe covers para-aramid 1414 filament. Domestic materials makers may draw attention, but an investigation is not a final tariff decision. Source: MOFCOM.
Filing
Jiesun Intelligence signs RMB4.915 billion computing-service contract
The tentative five-year contract is billed monthly with phased delivery. Customer execution, capex, delivery timing and margins remain key risks. Source: CLS weekend filing roundup.
Filing
CPIC Fiberglass plans RMB1.158 billion electronic-fabric project
The project targets 111 million metres of electronic-grade glass-fibre fabric annually over an roughly 11-month build. Ramp-up and end demand determine monetization. Source: CLS weekend filing roundup.
Hong Kong
HKEX posts double-digit nine-month revenue and profit growth
Revenue and other income rose 12% to HK$24.6 billion and shareholder profit rose 15% to HK$15.4 billion. Yet the shares closed Nov 6 at HK$385.60, down 2.28%, creating a fundamental-price divergence. Sources: HKEX, close.
Filing
Huaxin plans a roughly $1.642 billion Brazil cement acquisition
Huaxin plans to buy 99.99% of CSN Cimentos. The target lost money in 1H 2026 and the transaction still needs Chinese and Brazilian approvals. Huaxin closed Nov 6 at RMB27.46, up 2.16%, before the weekend filing. Sources: CNINFO, price.
Hong Kong
Time Interconnect plans up to HK$500 million of buybacks over 24 months
The plan would use internal resources, but the shares closed Nov 6 at HK$9.96, down 13.01%. The sharply negative same-day price reaction outweighs the headline. Sources: company filing index, price.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Index tape
Tech rebound confirms, but the Dow and rates remain divergent
At the Nov 6 close, QQQ was $656.10 (+1.40%), SPY $735.29 (+0.35%) and DIA $512.22 (-0.39%); SOX rebounded 4.2%. Strong payrolls also lifted yields, so this is a tech repair rather than a broad risk-on reset.
Sector check
Advertising, power and lidar lead while gambling remains weakest
Moomoo showed Advertising Agencies +6.73% and Independent Power Producers +6.68%; Lidar +14.57% and Crypto Mining +12.67% led concepts. Gambling fell 6.43%. Runtime quotes aligned for EVC, OKLO, INDI and IREN; no independent UURAF quote was available.
A/H mapping
Nuclear, rare-earth and sensor mappings await the A/H open
Independent power, uranium and space create potential mappings to A/H nuclear equipment, critical materials and aerospace; lidar maps to vehicle sensors. Friday's A/H breadth remained weak, so these are potential reversals awaiting Monday confirmation. Gambling is a negative Macau read-through; advertising has no clean mapping.

Premarket View

Policy: market stabilization, swap facilities and Six Networks provide support for financials, infrastructure and computing chains.

Overseas: strong payrolls lifted December hike odds to roughly 78%, while the 10-year yield near 4.86% caps valuation expansion.

Execution: A/H markets have not opened. All cards use Nov 6 closes or weekend filings and require Monday price and volume confirmation.

Key Stock Watchlist

Huaxin Building Materials
600801.SH / 06655.HK
Conditional watch

Facts and status: Huaxin plans to buy 99.99% of Brazil's second-largest cement producer for about $1.642 billion. Its A shares closed Nov 6 at RMB27.46, up 2.16%, before the weekend filing.

Confirmation: Hold RMB27.46 after the open, outperform building materials, and provide executable funding, approval and integration progress.

Risk / invalidation: The target lost money in 1H 2026 and the deal faces FX, refinancing and regulatory risks. A sustained break below the prior close invalidates the watch.

Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing
00388.HK
Conditional watch

Facts and status: Nine-month revenue and profit rose 12% and 15%, but the shares closed the results day at HK$385.60, down 2.28%, so price did not confirm the headline.

Confirmation: Recover the HK$388 opening area, outperform the Hang Seng Index, and sustain trading and IPO revenue momentum.

Risk / invalidation: Lower turnover, a weaker IPO cycle or a break below the HK$382.40 session low invalidates the watch.

Time Interconnect Technology
01729.HK
Avoid

Facts and status: The company plans up to HK$500 million of buybacks over 24 months, but the shares closed Nov 6 at HK$9.96, down 13.01%, a clear negative price response.

Reassessment: Actual buyback execution, normalized volume and a recovery above the HK$10.66 session high.

Risk / invalidation: Authorization is not completed buying, and volatility/liquidity risks are high. It is not presented as a bullish idea before a price reversal.

Sector Rotation Board

Policy supportMarket stabilization, buyback relending and Six Networks help financial, infrastructure and computing sentiment
Overseas repairSemiconductors, lidar, power and uranium rebounded, but strong jobs and high yields cap valuations
Event themesCross-border M&A, computing contracts, electronic materials and robot IDs require delivery or approval evidence
Pressure areasGambling, sharply negative price feedback and volatile small caps; buyback intent cannot erase price weakness

Logic Chain

Strong payrolls → higher hike odds and yields → caution on expensive A/H technology.
QQQ/SOX rebound + lidar, power and uranium leadership → sensor, nuclear and materials mappings → wait for the A/H open.
Stabilization policy + Six Networks and buyback relending → policy floor for sentiment → still requires stock-level price confirmation.
Huaxin M&A and HKEX earnings have business evidence → mixed price feedback → conditional watches only.
Time Interconnect buyback intent + 13.01% drop → negative price feedback dominates → avoid.

Risk Radar

Rates and valuationStrong US jobs raise hike odds and could reverse the tech rebound.
M&A and contract executionLarge announced values still face approvals, funding, delivery and margin risks.
Negative price feedbackTime Interconnect and HKEX lacked immediate confirmation; headlines do not override the tape.
